Controls for the benign library package triage.

The JavaScript positive control retains IPC messaging, an Artifactory URL,
an HTTP Host prefix, a camera permission phrase, an AI approval phrase and
CORS header names. All five tightened rules match. The negative control uses
an identity-provider method, a Go-style import path, a protobuf debug label,
a generic access grant and OAuth auto-approval; none of those five rules match.

The Python positive control retains an ORM Field constructor; the negative
control uses an SDK command constructor. Only the ORM declaration matches.

DomainName labels, readonly name literal types and cloudfront.net references
are neutral observations. CORS names belong with HTTP headers; ORM fields
belong with database declarations; port-forward name tokens do not assert
structured serialization. Consumers were updated for the moved trait IDs.

The three complete package scans have no suspicious or hostile traits.
OpenShift's embedded gzip byte array decompresses to a protobuf descriptor.
All archives have safe member paths and no link members.

Validation uses the local rebuilt cleave engine. Its directory whitelist was
updated to admit the seven directories already documented by TAXONOMY.md:
crypto encrypt/decrypt, network route/qos/forward/neighbors, and file entropy.
The installed scanner required CLEAVE_VALIDATE=0 to scan this newer tree.
